changes_made.explanation: Removed all metadata as the paper does NOT conduct human evaluation. The paper mentions manual verification but this appears to be for filtering test sets, not systematic human evaluation of generated outputs

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automated card game prototyping using LLMs, with NLG tasks including game mechanic design, code generation, and game variation generation. Evaluation is primarily automated using custom metrics tailored to the domain. LLM-as-judge is used specifically for Play Record Consistency evaluation using Claude-3-5-Sonnet. No systematic human evaluation was conducted.
